decisions.title: Source accepted; depth = Comprehensive
decisions.description: Source = AI-ILC Approved Idea Brief (Mode E, chain). Type = Greenfield; complexity = High (accessibility + privacy/regulatory). Comprehensive depth selected for full governance treatment.

decisions.title: Multi-region v1: build to stricter of GDPR + HIPAA
decisions.description: Target market = multi-region from v1. Engineer to stricter of GDPR + HIPAA-style; per-jurisdiction consent and data residency. Raises compliance scope/cost; satisfies ILC approval condition.

decisions.title: Platform = cross-platform iOS + Android
decisions.description: One codebase covers both at ~single build cost for Phase 1. Sets tech approach and team skills requirement.

decisions.title: Core reminders fully offline
decisions.description: Reminders are safety-relevant; must fire without connectivity. Rest degrades gracefully. Drives local-store + scheduler architecture.

decisions.title: Identity = person-owned; caregiver invited w/ consent
decisions.description: Strengthens dignity and 'not surveillance' positioning. Person controls access; single caregiver in v1. Defines auth and data model.

decisions.title: Proceed with conditions (feasibility challenging)
decisions.description: Feasibility score 55/100 (Challenging). Product merit strong and already phased. Blockers are funding/resourcing (addressable), not merit. 4 conditions set.

decisions.title: Mobile-AI = hybrid; light on-device in P1
decisions.description: On-device for sensitive inference (faces, mood) preserves privacy/dignity and offline. Cloud LLM (Claude) only for non-sensitive conversation. P1 = on-device person-recognition assist; rest P2.

decisions.title: Business Case approved (revised for CR-1)
decisions.description: Strong merit, phased, privacy-defensible. ROM - (P1). Funding is the blocking condition.

decisions.title: Project Charter approved as-is
decisions.description: Charter captures purpose, scope, milestones, governance, and proceed-with-conditions posture. 3 governance roles (PM, PO, Privacy/Compliance) remain TBD.

decisions.title: Product Vision & Goals approved
decisions.description: 7 goals (G1-G7) across 4 themes (T1-T4). Pilot-baselined metrics. Hard gates on safety (G3) and privacy (G6). No contradictions with Charter scope.

decisions.title: PO Charter & Authority defined
decisions.description: PO = Mahe (acting); delegation clause for future hire. Strategic-only escalation avoids bottleneck. Shared safety/privacy stop-authority (PO + Privacy/Compliance, Sponsor tiebreak). RACI covers 14 activities.

decisions.title: Product roadmap established (4 themes, 3 horizons)
decisions.description: Now: 11 capabilities (Phase-1 build). Next: 7 (pilot to launch). Later: 11 (Phase-2 directional). Value proposition: dignity + reconnection wedge. Outcome-based, not date-based.

risks.title: Funding not secured (blocking)
risks.description: No confirmed budget envelope. ROM - for Phase 1. Without funding, project cannot proceed past initiation. Mitigation: articulate in Business Case; explore grants, angel, bootstrapping.

changes.title: Add mobile AI (4 capabilities; hybrid; light AI in Phase 1)
changes.description: Added 4 AI capabilities: person recognition assist, mood inference, conversational companion, predictive routine adjustment. Architecture = hybrid (on-device sensitive + cloud non-sensitive). P1 scope = light on-device only. Impact: +- cost, +4-6 weeks, new ML skill needed.

actions.title: Define measurable accessibility acceptance criteria
actions.description: Need WCAG level + task-completion targets with representative users (people with cognitive impairment). Deferred from requirements analysis (FIND-005).

actions.title: Identify funding source / budget envelope (blocking)
actions.description: Feasibility condition 1. No funding source confirmed. ROM - Phase 1. Options: grants, angel, bootstrapping, employer sponsorship.

actions.title: Confirm jurisdiction list + data-residency approach (blocking)
actions.description: Feasibility condition 2. Multi-region (D-3) requires specific jurisdiction list and data-residency strategy before architecture can be designed.

actions.title: Assemble team (dev, accessibility/UX, privacy/compliance)
actions.description: Feasibility condition 4. Need: cross-platform developer(s), accessibility/UX specialist, privacy/compliance advisor. Solo founder currently.

actions.title: Secure AI/ML capability (on-device ML + Claude)
actions.description: CR-1 requirement. Need on-device ML for face/mood (TFLite/CoreML) + Claude API integration for cloud conversation. Skill gap identified.

actions.title: Validate person-recognition accuracy + dignity-safe failure
actions.description: CR-1 risk mitigation. System must never assert wrong identity. Needs confidence thresholds and graceful degradation ('I think this might be...' vs definitive claim).

issues.title: Multi-region compliance complexity (GDPR+HIPAA, residency)
issues.description: Multi-region launch (D-3) greatly increases compliance complexity. Need: multi-jurisdiction consent frameworks, lawful basis per region, data residency solution. Resolution: engineer to stricter standard; confirm jurisdiction list at architecture phase.

vision.statement: Empower people living with Alzheimer's to maintain daily routines independently and with dignity, while giving caregivers peace of mind through a companion app that is simple, safe, and respectful.

compliance.target: Pass GDPR + HIPAA audit before launch

adrs.title: Cloud Relay — AWS Lambda + API Gateway + SQS

principles.name: Privacy Is Architecture, Not Policy
principles.summary: Sensitive data architecturally prevented from leaving device — no code path can transmit it

principles.name: Offline-First, Online-Enhanced
principles.summary: Person-facing experience complete without network. Online enhances, never enables core

principles.name: Two Experiences, One Data Layer
principles.summary: Separate UI architectures (person + caregiver) sharing encrypted local data layer

principles.name: Silence Over Wrong
principles.summary: When uncertain, stay silent. A wrong suggestion causes more harm than a missed one

principles.name: Consent Is Structural, Not Declarative
principles.summary: Caregiver access enforced at data layer — no consent token = no data flow

principles.name: Minimal Cloud Surface
principles.summary: Cloud only for: push notifications, Phase-2 LLM, app distribution. No sensitive data transits cloud

principles.name: Graceful Degradation by Design
principles.summary: Every layer has a defined degradation path. Nothing is catastrophic

principles.name: Compliance by Construction
principles.summary: GDPR/HIPAA achieved through architectural patterns, not bolt-on compliance layer

principles.name: Small Team, Modular Architecture
principles.summary: ~4-5 FTE. Modular monolith over microservices. Clear boundaries, single deployment

principles.name: Accessibility Is a Foundation, Not a Feature
principles.summary: WCAG 2.2 AA+ structurally supported from component architecture to data model

vision.statement: A privacy-sovereign, offline-first mobile system delivering two architecturally distinct experiences — a zero-navigation push-based companion for the person with Alzheimer's, and a consent-gated oversight view for their caregiver — unified by an encrypted on-device data layer.

constraints.impact: No cloud DB for user data. On-device encryption. Status-only sync
Consent management, audit trail, data minimization, right-to-erasure
No diagnostic claims. Avoids FDA/CE classification
Person is primary. Caregiver access delegated
CoreML/TFLite. Must run on consumer phones
Strict content filtering. No PII in prompts
Simple access model. Multi-caregiver not precluded
Hard safety gate in ML pipeline. Not configurable

journeys.name: Margaret Daily Routine
journeys.goal: Complete critical daily tasks (medication, meals, hygiene) without shame or confusion
journeys.trigger: Time-based: the app determines it's time for the next routine item
journeys.endStateSuccess: Margaret completes the task, feels capable, card dismissed
journeys.endStateFailure: Margaret doesn't respond; after grace period, caregiver is alerted (invisible to Margaret)
journeys.duration: 1-3 minutes per reminder interaction (recurring throughout the day)
journeys.frequency: Daily — 6-10 interactions per day across medication, meals, hygiene

journeys.name: Margaret Reconnection
journeys.goal: Recognize a familiar person and feel connected rather than panicked
journeys.trigger: Margaret browses the familiar-people album OR on-device recognition suggests a match
journeys.endStateSuccess: Margaret confidently recognizes the person, feels warmth and connection
journeys.endStateFailure: Recognition uncertain; system remains silent (no wrong assertion); Margaret may feel unsure

journeys.name: Margaret Emergency
journeys.goal: Reach a trusted person immediately when scared, confused, or in danger
journeys.trigger: Margaret feels frightened, confused, or unsafe — instinctive reach for help
journeys.endStateSuccess: Margaret is connected to someone who can help; she feels safer
journeys.endStateFailure: Margaret can't find or operate the help button; nobody responds
journeys.duration: 5-30 seconds (tap to alert); 1-5 minutes (until human response)
journeys.frequency: Rare (0-2 times per week; hopefully less)

journeys.name: David Monitoring
journeys.goal: Know Mum is okay without actively checking; alerted instantly for critical events only
journeys.trigger: Passive: absence of alerts = fine; OR Active: David opens app to glance
journeys.endStateSuccess: David feels reassured (passive) or sees calm 'all fine' summary (active)
journeys.endStateFailure: David receives a critical alert and must take action

journeys.name: David Onboarding
journeys.goal: Configure app for Margaret in one session: routines, album, consent — then leave knowing it works
journeys.trigger: David downloads the app and decides 'today I'll set this up for Mum'
journeys.endStateSuccess: App fully configured; Margaret consented; test reminder fires successfully
journeys.endStateFailure: Setup abandoned mid-way (too long, too confusing, consent conversation went badly)

journeys.name: David Routine Update
journeys.goal: Update Margaret's routines when schedule or medication changes
journeys.trigger: Doctor changes medication time; season changes meal patterns; new appointment
journeys.endStateSuccess: Updated routine is live on Margaret's phone; David confirms it took effect
journeys.endStateFailure: Update doesn't sync; Margaret gets reminders at wrong times

journeys.name: Rachel Emergency Response
journeys.goal: Receive help alert, understand situation, coordinate appropriate response
journeys.trigger: Margaret presses 'I need help'; system dispatches alert to all contacts
journeys.endStateSuccess: Rachel confirms Margaret is safe (directly or via David); alert resolved
journeys.endStateFailure: Rachel doesn't see the alert; nobody responds; Margaret alone in distress
journeys.frequency: Rare (0-2 times per month; hopefully less)

flows.name: Routine Reminder
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Scheduler: reminder due] --> B[Play chime + wake screen]
    B --> C[Display reminder card]
    C --> D{Margaret responds?}
    D -->|Taps 'Done'| E[Log completion locally]
    D -->|Taps 'Later'| F[Dismiss card + set defer timer]
    D -->|No response| G[Wait grace period]
    E --> H[Show ✓ animation + return to idle]
    F --> I[Defer timer expires]
    I --> B
    G --> J{Grace period expired?}
    J -->|No| G
    J -->|Yes| K[Silent caregiver alert]
    K --> L[Margaret's screen: unchanged / idle]
    H --> M[Idle state: 'You're all set' or next card]

flows.name: Recognition Assist
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Face detected in image/camera] --> B[On-device ML processes face]
    B --> C{Confidence ≥ threshold?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Display suggestion card]
    C -->|No| E[Do nothing - silence]
    D --> F{Margaret responds?}
    F -->|Taps 'Yes' / smiles| G[Log positive match]
    F -->|Taps 'Not sure'| H[Dismiss suggestion gently]
    F -->|No response - 30s| I[Auto-fade suggestion]
    G --> J[Card fades with warm animation]
    H --> J
    I --> J
    J --> K[Return to previous state]
    E --> K

flows.name: Help Button
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Margaret taps 'I need help'] --> B[Alert dispatched immediately - NO confirmation]
    B --> C[Margaret's screen: 'Help is coming. David knows.']
    B --> D[Push to David + Rachel simultaneously]
    C --> E[Optional: auto-dial primary contact after 10s]
    D --> F{Any contact responds?}
    F -->|Yes within 5 min| G[Update Margaret's screen: 'David is calling you']
    F -->|No within 5 min| H[Auto-retry + escalate to secondary]
    H --> I{Secondary responds?}
    I -->|Yes| G
    I -->|No within 10 min| J[Dial emergency services if configured]
    G --> K[Human contact made - flow complete]

flows.name: Album Browsing
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Margaret taps 'My People'] --> B{Album has people?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Display photo grid - large cards]
    B -->|No| D[Warm empty state: 'David will add your people soon']
    C --> E[Margaret browses / scrolls]
    E --> F[Taps a person's card]
    F --> G[Enlarged photo + name + relationship]
    G --> H[Margaret looks, recognizes, feels warm]
    H --> I{Done browsing?}
    I -->|Taps back / swipe| C
    I -->|Presses home / idle timeout| J[Return to idle]
    D --> J

flows.name: Critical Alert Response
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Grace period expires on Margaret's device] --> B[System classifies: critical?]
    B -->|Critical| C[Push notification to David]
    B -->|Non-critical| D[Log only - no alert]
    C --> E[David sees notification]
    E --> F{David taps notification?}
    F -->|Yes| G[Alert detail screen]
    F -->|No response 5 min| H[Push to Rachel + escalation]
    G --> I{David's action?}
    I -->|Call Margaret| J[One-tap call]
    I -->|Snooze 15 min| K[Delay re-alert]
    I -->|Mark resolved| L[Close alert]
    J --> M[Call connected - David assesses]
    M --> L
    K --> N[15 min later: re-alert if still unresolved]
    N --> G
    L --> O[Alert status: Resolved by David at HH:MM]
    O --> P[Rachel notified: 'Resolved']
    H --> Q[Rachel receives alert + context]

flows.name: Onboarding Wizard
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[David opens app on Margaret's phone] --> B[Welcome screen: '30 minutes to set up']
    B --> C[Step 1: Create Margaret's profile - name + photo]
    C --> D[Step 2: Set up routines]
    D --> D1[Morning routines]
    D1 --> D2[Afternoon routines]
    D2 --> D3[Evening routines]
    D3 --> E[Step 3: Add familiar people]
    E --> E1[Import photos + add names/relationships]
    E1 --> F[Step 4: Consent]
    F --> F1[Margaret's phone shows visual consent card]
    F1 --> F2{Margaret taps Yes?}
    F2 -->|Yes| G[Consent recorded]
    F2 -->|No / Confused| H[Person-only mode - no caregiver link]
    G --> I[Step 5: Pair David's phone]
    I --> I1[QR code or 4-digit code]
    I1 --> J[Step 6: Test reminder]
    J --> J1[Fire test reminder on Margaret's phone]
    J1 --> J2[David sees completion on his phone]
    J2 --> K[Setup complete - summary screen]
    H --> L[Setup complete in person-only mode]
    L --> M[David can re-request consent later]
